messages:
nora: Thanks for coming to the all-hands — dropping a short thread to capture hiring & team-alignment Qs. I know there are a lot of follow-ups; I’ll update this thread as we get firm answers.

james: Can you confirm which teams are getting net new headcount vs backfills? The slides were high-level.

nora: Short answer: targeted net new. Leadership approved a focused push: ~12 net hires this quarter, tilted toward Serving Runtime and Platform (Console/SDKs). A few product squads will be reduced and those reqs may become backfills or be paused. Final approvals will land after finance review next Wed.

leah: Clarifying process: hiring manager opens req -> recruiting triage -> hiring council review -> finance sign-off for net new. Internal postings get a 5-business-day internal window by default.

omar: If my PM role is merged, will I be auto-assigned or can I apply elsewhere internally first?

leah: You won’t be auto-reassigned. Internal mobility encouraged: talk to your manager, apply for internal roles. Payroll remains unchanged during interviews. Recruiting will support transitions and keep timelines tight.

tal: What about leveling/title changes for people moved into different pillars?

nora: No forced demotions. Managers will propose mappings; HR will validate and document any changes. If comp adjustments are needed, HR will schedule 1:1s within 7 business days. We’ll publish a level-mapping cheat sheet and sample cases in #people-ops.

recruiting-bot: Reminder: submit all new reqs in Greenhouse by EOD Friday to be evaluated in the next hiring council cycle.

omar: Oncall/load concerns — merged squads could spike rotations. How are we mitigating burnout?

james: Good point. Leads will publish a temporary 4-week overlap rota and add a 1-SE float for infra-heavy weeks. If you’re at capacity, escalate to your manager and we’ll reassign coverage.

leah: We’ll also run dedicated manager office hours next Tue/Wed to walk through level mapping and workload transition checklists. Invite posted.

nora: Transparency: we’ll publish a weekly headcount snapshot in #finance and add a small dashboard widget in the internal console (fields: total FTEs, open reqs, approvals pending, hiring runway). Example snapshot we plan to publish:

``
Snapshot: 2026-03-22
Total FTEs: 156
Open reqs: 9 (4 awaiting council)
Planned net new (Q2): 10-14
Priority: runtime=7, platform=3, cs=2
``

omar: Any contingency if we miss targets? layoffs? freezes?

nora: No planned layoffs. We have contingency scenarios if macro conditions deteriorate; leadership commits to as much notice and support as possible. For now, focus is reallocating to core bets while keeping mobility options open.

recruiting-bot: Internal Mobility Drop-in — Tomorrow 10:00am PT. Calendar invite sent.

nora: Action items: HR to publish level-mapping guide (leah), recruiting to share req template & timeline (owner: recruiting team), leads to post updated org charts and RACI by Mon. DM your manager for role-specific concerns and cc recruiting. Thanks everyone.
